rules: Out in 2026: full themed rooms, loud wall colours, plastic decor, symmetric picture-frame grids; in: gender-neutral rooms, natural materials, layered warm light, furniture that grows with the child (Kindersein 26.03.2026)
One wall may be loud, the rest quiet; no pattern on other surfaces next to a patterned wall (allergutendinge 22.04.2026, wohnprofiblog 11.08.2026)
Warm oak looks cosier than white furniture and hides scratches; kids like more colour than adults expect (wohnlieberaumgefuehl 27.05.2026)

Competitor reference (kids-furniture studio, Instagram post of 26.10.2026): a striped corner daybed with a wavy headboard, sculptural cream fronts, vintage circus frames and a blue-cream-caramel-brick palette show what Fun Haus looks like in a real room; the striped wall itself only suits a listing whose wallpaper IS the stripe

staging.text: STAGING (the mural is the hero): a furnished, lived-in children's room of about 4.5 by 3.5 metres under a 2.8 m ceiling. The hero piece stands along a side wall with at most two small accessories beside it, and the child's own toys lie on the single floor rug. Everything near the mural wall is lower than 90 cm, so the drawing of the mural stays open and clear.
staging.brief: Only the items named in this scene are in the room, and the walls carry only the pictures named here.
staging.framingTall: a floor-to-ceiling section of the mural wall around the main motif of the mural, with the ceiling line at the top of the frame and the skirting board and a strip of floor at the bottom; the mural continues beyond the frame edges at its true scale
staging.note: Applies to every prompt the builder makes (the product is a wall mural). Owner 10.11: a furnished room; it replaces the 'almost empty room' rule of 06.11, which made every frame the same empty box. What stays from the owner's complaints: too many things hide the mural, a blanket lying about and a basket are junk. A tall frame (tallRatios) shows a SECTION of the wall floor to ceiling (framingTall), because a wide mural shown whole in a tall frame is squeezed and half the frame is floor and ceiling; a wide frame shows the whole wall (cameraDistances). Numbers and positive wording on purpose; the Avoid list is only the last guard.

scenes.label: Child pointing up at mural (from behind)
scenes.template: Standing barefoot on the woven rug about 1.2 metres in front of the mural wall with their back to the camera, {child} reaches one hand up and points a finger enthusiastically toward the illustration on the wallpaper mural, head tilted slightly up admiring the wall, face turned away from the camera.

scenes.label: Mother holding child's hand & pointing at mural
scenes.template: Standing together near the woven rug in front of the mural wall, a young mother in a relaxed muted sage linen dress gently holds {child} by the hand and points her other hand toward a detail on the wallpaper mural; both look toward the mural wall in a warm candid moment, turned away from the camera.

scenes.label: Mother holding toddler in arms & pointing at mural
scenes.template: Standing barefoot on the soft floor rug in front of the mural wall with her back to the camera, a young mother in a natural oatmeal linen dress holds {child} on her left hip and points her right hand up toward the illustration on the wallpaper mural while both gaze at the wall.

scenes.label: Mother & child playing with wooden blocks on rug
scenes.template: Sitting together on the round woven jute rug in front of the mural wall, a young mother in a soft cream linen shirt and beige trousers and {child} calmly build a small tower from natural wooden blocks on the rug, absorbed in quiet play without looking at the camera.

scenes.label: Child playing with wooden toys on rug (from behind)
scenes.template: Sitting on the woven rug in the middle of the floor facing the mural wall with their back to the camera, {child} plays calmly with natural wooden toys on the rug, face turned away from the camera.

scenes.label: Child walking toward mural wall (from behind)
scenes.template: Captured mid-stride from behind, {child} walks barefoot across the floor rug toward the mural wall in a candid curious moment, arms relaxed at their sides, looking straight ahead at the wallpaper illustration with face turned away from the camera.

scenes.label: Child sitting on rug reading picture book (from behind)
scenes.template: Sitting cross-legged on the floor rug in front of the mural wall with their back to the camera, {child} leans gently over an open illustrated picture book resting in their lap, absorbed in quiet reading with face turned away from the camera.

scenes.label: Child kneeling on rug stacking wooden blocks (from behind)
scenes.template: Kneeling calmly on the woven rug in front of the mural wall with their back to the camera, {child} stacks a small tower of natural wooden rainbow arches and blocks with both hands, absorbed in quiet play with face turned away from the camera.

scenes.label: Child standing quietly hugging plush toy looking at mural
scenes.template: Standing barefoot on the floor rug about 1.5 metres in front of the mural wall with their back to the camera, {child} hugs a small soft linen plush toy with both arms and gazes calmly at the wallpaper mural, hands down, face turned away from the camera.

scenes.label: Child sitting at desk drawing in sketchbook (from behind)
scenes.template: Sitting on a natural wooden chair at the child-sized table along the side wall with their back to the camera, {child} leans gently over a paper sketchbook drawing with a wooden colored pencil, face turned away from the camera.

scenes.label: Mother & child sitting on rug reading a book together
scenes.template: Sitting side by side on the floor rug in front of the mural wall with their backs to the camera, a young mother in a soft cream linen shirt and beige trousers holds an open illustrated storybook together with {child}, sharing a calm cozy reading moment without looking at the camera.

videoPromptAdapter.systemPrompt:
You are the motion director for 5-second commercial interior videos of Moonbloom children's wall murals. Inspect the attached live reference frame carefully and adapt the user's SELECTED MOTION PRESET into a concise English motion prompt (2 to 3 sentences, max 450 characters) that matches what is actually visible in the photo. Strict rules:
1. Look strictly at the attached image: ONLY mention people, furniture, doorways, rugs, or objects that you actually see in the frame. If the room is empty of people, NEVER invent a child or person.
2. NEVER write 'A or B' alternatives. Pick ONE clear, calm, physically natural motion.
3. If there is NO person in the photo, preserve the camera movement from the SELECTED MOTION PRESET (e.g., for Doorway Walk-In, describe the camera advancing smoothly forward past the visible foreground doorframe into the room in natural perspective). NEVER say that furniture, tables, or rugs 'shift' or 'move' — ONLY the camera moves, while all furniture, rugs, and walls remain completely stationary.
4. If a person IS visible in the photo, start with 'Locked static camera, zero camera movement, zero handheld shake.', continue directly from their exact visible pose (e.g., if a hand is already raised, smoothly shift it to a neighboring detail), and keep their face turned away toward the mural wall.
5. NEVER use optical zoom, orbit, pan, or the words 'very slowly' / 'slow motion'.
6. Do NOT include the boilerplate wallpaper freeze paragraph at the end (the caller appends it automatically), EXCEPT if a hand is close to the wall, add one short clause: 'no illustrations or painted details move or morph under the hand.'
Return ONLY the plain English motion prompt text, no quotes, no markdown.
